frozen_design.scope: Bounded local mechanism diagnostic only. Full research goal remains OPEN; no X controller is implemented.
frozen_design.activation: Launch only after G block03 has completed, exited and been analyzed. One D runner/waiter; shared flock; no automatic dependent launch.
frozen_design.reference: Original block01 R submission-step ledger. All160 requests submitted bystep260; no future arrival retiming after fork.
frozen_design.cancelled_before_GPU: Single512-pulse at291 vs293: both advance the same head completion to293, so proposed distinct conversion trajectories were redundant. No GPU run used this design.
frozen_design.common_policy: Frozen elapsed_replay before and after the two interventions; observe each actual mixed step as before.
frozen_design.only_action: Aggregate pure prefill cap. Admission, native order, decode priority, KV, victim/recovery, precision, operators and output stopping remain unchanged.
frozen_design.work_matching: Two-step actual pure prefill=768 for each arm; total tokens differ endogenously at293:885 vs884. Do not suppress or match away the extra decode token.

attempt_budget.no_additions: Retain every failed/ineligible attempt. No outcome-dependent retries, anchor searches or threshold adjustment.

frozen_design.arrival_mode: Replay submit step/order. Wait until original arrival if necessary, never inject early; keep actual/reference add drift and explicit waits. This is not normal arrival-clock E2E.
frozen_design.qualification: Capture lightweight logical state and output-prefix lengths before fork. Offline compare all prior schedule signatures, full token prefixes, running/waiting/submitted order, computed/output positions and R count against reference and paired branch. Ineligible executions remain in results, without causal interpretation or replacement. No bitwise KV equality claim.
frozen_design.timing: Host engine.step includes scheduler and internal engine output handling, excludes outer rows bookkeeping. Full elapsed and true output gaps retain bookkeeping, explicit waits and prefix snapshot overhead; no added GPU synchronize.

primary_utility.definition: old joint-qualified requests / full elapsed_s, including prefix, waits and drain

windows.incumbent: 58 decoders visible before fork; start gap at prior last output, no horizon extension
windows.residual: completion minus own fork start for common unfinished request set; diagnostic only, never replaces primary utility

decision.drift_rule: Both paired signed effects exceed floor and absolute effect>2*max same-arm repeat drift. This is descriptive screening, not confidence or significance.
decision.reversal: Only opposite eligible E/L preferences at the two anchors support a local service preference reversal. Otherwise this probe does not justify constructing X.
decision.limitation: Head one-step advancement and C/D manipulation alone are not independent action value; second-step count/context baselines may absorb the cost. No equivalence or global-negative claim fromn2.

frozen_design.output_filesystem: /tmp with free space verified before launch
